rules.message_pt: El Niño: açaí precisa de muita água. Plante só onde houver água confiável ou espere a chuva melhorar.
rules.message_en: El Niño: açaí needs a lot of water. Plant it only where water is reliable, or wait for rainfall to improve.

rules.message_pt: El Niño: cacau pode dar certo, mas as mudas novas precisam de sombra e proteção contra a seca.
rules.message_en: El Niño: cacao can work, but young seedlings need shade and protection from drought.

rules.message_pt: El Niño: cupuaçu pode precisar de mais sombra e água nos períodos secos.
rules.message_en: El Niño: cupuaçu may need more shade and water during dry periods.

rules.message_pt: Ingá dá sombra, protege o solo e os galhos podados viram cobertura (mulch).
rules.message_en: Ingá gives shade, protects the soil, and pruned branches become mulch.

rules.message_pt: Guandu: cortar e deixar sobre o solo devolve matéria orgânica e protege contra o sol.
rules.message_en: Pigeon pea (guandu): cutting it and leaving it on the soil returns organic matter and protects against the sun.

rules.message_pt: Mantenha o solo sempre coberto (folhas, galhos, mulch, plantas baixas). Solo nu esquenta e seca mais rápido.
rules.message_en: Keep the soil covered at all times (leaves, branches, mulch, low plants). Bare soil heats up and dries out faster.

rules.message_pt: Plante quando houver chuva e umidade no solo — não só pelo calendário. Mudas novas sofrem mais com a seca.
rules.message_en: Plant when there is rain and moisture in the soil, not just by the calendar. Young seedlings suffer most from drought.

rules.message_pt: Risco de fogo: mantenha aceiros limpos de material seco e deixe água disponível para emergência.
rules.message_en: Fire risk: keep firebreaks clear of dry material and keep water available for emergencies.

rules.message_pt: La Niña: mais risco de fungos no cacau (vassoura-de-bruxa, podridão-parda). Pode o dossel para circular o ar.
rules.message_en: La Niña: higher risk of fungal disease in cacao (witches' broom, black pod rot). Prune the canopy so air can circulate.

rules.message_pt: Com menos circulação de ar o jambu sofre com fungos (ferrugem-branca, manchas, podridão). Solução da planilha: podar as árvores.
rules.message_en: With less air circulation, jambu suffers from fungi (white rust, leaf spots, rot). Fix from the team sheet: prune the trees.

rules.message_pt: Chuva forte atrapalha colheita e transporte, principalmente em várzea. Planeje o escoamento e colha antes dos picos.
rules.message_en: Heavy rain disrupts harvest and transport, especially in floodplain (várzea) areas. Plan how to get produce out and harvest before the peaks.

rules.message_pt: Chicória prefere 30–70% de sombra; sol pleno estressa e faz a planta florescer cedo. Plante sob árvores.
rules.message_en: Chicória prefers 30–70% shade; full sun stresses it and makes it flower early. Plant under trees.

rules.message_pt: Cariru sofre com sol pleno na seca. Prefira sob copa média/alta (bananeira, ingá).
rules.message_en: Cariru suffers in full sun during the dry season. Prefer planting under a medium or high canopy (banana, ingá).

rules.message_pt: Jambu prefere meia-sombra; evite sol forte do meio-dia. Plante sob açaí, cupuaçu ou cacau.
rules.message_en: Jambu prefers partial shade; avoid strong midday sun. Plant under açaí, cupuaçu or cacao.

rules.message_pt: Faça análise de solo antes de plantar. O solo da região é ácido e pobre; calagem e fósforo só conforme o resultado.
rules.message_en: Test the soil before planting. Soils in the region are acidic and poor; add lime and phosphorus only according to the result.

sources.title: Horta da Terra ESG Policy
sources.supports: Company describes syntropic transformation, farmer knowledge-sharing, biodiversity, native Amazon species, and digital tools for partner production management.
sources.limitations: Policy describes commitments and approach; it is not a species-level technical planting manual.

sources.title: Horta da Terra project brief, reNature
sources.supports: Identifies location in Santo Antônio do Tauá, Pará; reports a 6 ha productive regenerative system and an additional 32 ha productive ecosystem at the time of the brief; describes scaling with a Model Farm and Model School.
sources.limitations: Historical project brief; verify current area, design, and status with Horta da Terra.

sources.title: Partnership for the Conservation of Amazon Biodiversity, 2022 Annual Report
sources.supports: Reports six plant species sold by Horta da Terra at that time: jambu, chicory, cariru, ora-pro-nóbis, roselle, and taioba; discusses small-farmer supply partnerships near Santo Antônio do Tauá.
sources.limitations: Historical snapshot, not confirmation of today's crop portfolio or exact scientific names for common names.

sources.title: Embrapa: Multi-strata agroforestry system with native Amazonian plants cultivated in acid soil (2012)
sources.supports: Documents Amazonian timber, palm, and fruit species grown in a multi-strata system on acid soil, including rubber, kapok, jacaranda, breu, peach palm, açaí, biribá, cacao, cupuaçu, sorva, and camu-camu.
sources.limitations: Central Amazon research context; do not transfer species performance or prescriptions directly to Santo Antônio do Tauá without local validation.

sources.title: Embrapa: Effects of canopy species over Theobroma grandiflorum in agroforestry systems in the Brazilian Amazon (2025)
sources.supports: Shows canopy-tree choice can affect cupuaçu production and survival; compares mahogany and Khaya grandifoliola in trials in Tomé-Açu, Pará.
sources.limitations: Useful evidence that shade-tree identity matters; site and crop context differ from Horta da Terra's leafy PANC systems.

sources.title: Embrapa: Plant composition and species use in agroforestry homegardens in the Eastern Amazon, Brazil
sources.supports: Survey of 119 homegardens in western Pará documenting 5,323 plants from 188 species; useful for regional species discovery and diversified planting context.
sources.limitations: Inventory is not a compatibility trial; presence together does not prove agronomic compatibility.

sources.title: Crops Horta da Terra spreadsheet (team research)
sources.supports: Layer, light, soil, pathogens, layout, intercropping for 19 species
sources.limitations: Detail filled for only 3 species (jambu, chicória, cariru); compiled by students, not field-validated
